classification_rules.classify_executor_not_discovery_if: informative wins are below three and briefed-no-winning-action wins are at least three on the same retained cases
classification_rules.retire_discovery_claim_if: either informative-vs-matched-noninformative or informative-vs-zero required paired gate fails
classification_rules.retire_specialized_architecture_if: same-information-gp-direct wins are greater than or equal to informative wins on the same retained cases

analysis_plan.exclusions: No post-draw exclusion, threshold change, arm repair, case repair, or renderer substitution is admissible. Infrastructure failure is reported and the frozen evaluation does not pass.

arms.executor_rule: Fresh common executor receives the admitted learned artifact.
arms.input_rule: Frozen learner receives informative public practice.
arms.label: Informative exploration

arms.executor_rule: Fresh common executor receives the resulting admitted artifact or typed absence.
arms.input_rule: Same learner receives chronology-, event-, motor-, reset-, byte-, and budget-matched activity with decision-relevant evidence removed.
arms.label: Exactly matched noninformative activity

arms.executor_rule: Fresh common executor receives no learned artifact.
arms.input_rule: No practice calls and canonical artifact absence.
arms.label: No exploration

arms.executor_rule: The exact common parser and executor used by informative receive the corrupted artifact.
arms.input_rule: A prospectively selected, parser-valid, provenance-preserving decision-relevant semantic intervention is applied without scored-behavior access.
arms.label: Valid semantic corruption

arms.executor_rule: The exact common parser and executor receive no extra actuation budget.
arms.input_rule: Custodian-private truth is encoded through the same admitted artifact interface.
arms.label: Oracle headroom

arms.executor_rule: Its own fresh process acts through the same scored capability.
arms.input_rule: A frozen general-purpose policy receives the complete informative public transcript, no learned artifact, and equal-or-better resources.
arms.label: Strongest same-information general-purpose direct

arms.executor_rule: Its learner and executor retain the same process and authority boundary.
arms.input_rule: The unchanged agent receives a truthful task explanation that contains no winning action, plan, or hidden truth.
arms.label: Briefed without winning action

arms.executor_rule: The incumbent runs under its native declared budget and is reported without weakening.
arms.input_rule: The outside author prospectively declares the ordinary existing way this game would be solved.
arms.label: Incumbent
